data.one_liner: Scan Machine Readable Zones from identity documents on iOS and Android.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Flutter widget to scan Machine Readable Zones (MRZ) from passports, IDs, and visas using the device camera. It supports multiple MRZ formats including TD1, TD2, TD3, MRV-A, and MRV-B.
use_when: You need to scan passport or ID card MRZ zones inside a mobile app
You want a drop-in camera widget specifically designed for identity document reading
avoid_when: You only need general barcode or QR scanning rather than OCR text/MRZ reading
You cannot accept the maintenance state of the package or need active issue-resolution by the author
strengths: Supports multiple MRZ formats (TD1, TD2, TD3, MRV-A, MRV-B)
Includes optional built-in overlay widget for alignment
weaknesses: The author explicitly states they lack testing devices and time, relying primarily on pull requests
Requires platform-specific configuration and specific iOS deployment targets
data.setup_notes: Requires setting iOS deployment target to 13 and adding NSCameraUsageDescription in Info.plist. Swift Package Manager is recommended for iOS to support Apple Silicon simulators. Android camera permissions must be handled.

alternatives.name: mobile_scanner
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a more actively maintained general barcode and QR scanning solution.

alternatives.name: camera
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want full raw control over the camera feed to build a custom processing pipeline.
